description: BOSTON, MA — The SEIU State Council today announced their endorsement of Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for re-election, citing her record of fighting for service workers, holding corporations accountable for exploitation, and delivering real results for the working families who keep Massachusetts running.

title: SEIU State Council Endorses Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for Re-Election - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
